'''ZX-199 ''' was an elite [[Skytrooper]], a type of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. In [[3631 BBY]], it was destroyed by [[Lana Beniko]] and [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]] inside the skytrooper droid factory on Zakuul.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
ZX-199 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter 3: Outlander'''.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' {{1st}}
